newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian stocks end little changed in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: Colombian stocks end little changed in quiet trade.

text.p: Colombian stocks ended little changed in quiet trading Friday.

Medellin's IBOMED general price index fell a paper-thin 0.03 percent to close at 13,200.24 on a volume of 1.13 billion pesos. Bogota's IBB ended up 0.36 percent, however, closing at 835.19 on a below-average volume of 730.8 million pesos.
"It was a pretty weak session," one Bogota-based trader said.
He noted, nonetheless, that Banco Ganadero shares managed to eke out their first gain since the bank's equity sale Tuesday.
Ganadero, the country's top bank in terms of assets, saw its ordinary shares rise 0.38 percent in Bogota, ending at 263 pesos per share on a volume of more than 130 million pesos of shares.

Brewer Bavaria SA was the day's biggest winner by far, ending up 1.35 percent at 3,750. Other banks among the day's gainers included Banco de Colombia, up 0.58 percent at 427.50 pesos a share, and Banco de Bogota, which ended up 0.53 percent at 5,630 pesos per share.
"The rises came on fairly low volumes," said Arturo Gonzalez of brokerage Afin SA.
"Still," he added, "there are shares that have come under demand because their prices had fallen."

In Medellin, confectionery Compania Nacional de Chocolates accounted for more than half of the day's trading volume. But it closed almost unchanged at 8,350 pesos per share, up a barely noticeably 0.01 percent on the day.

Ganadero, meanwhile, extended its losses over the previous two days in Medellin. Its ordinary shares ended down another 2.60 percent while its preferential shares shed an additional 2.25 percent. -- Javier Mozzo, Bogota newsroom, 571 610 7944
